integrity: Exhaustive finite trace test with a separately implemented incidence cross-check, proof of absence of larger shattered supports, reproducible standard-library Python code; not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for AG(2,4) only, with two distinct component lines; no extension to all finite affine planes, and no online rank statement. General two-line VC dimension five and the two real-plane five-point incidence types are credited to earlier literature. Historical priority cannot be certified by finite search.
title: Parallelism-sensitive VC-shattering in the affine plane of order four
